description:
Ad Reporting by PaidSync.ai reports on the ad accounts you own across ten ad platforms, when you ask ChatGPT in plain language.

What you can do:
- Report spend, clicks, conversions and cost per result for the dates you choose.
- Break Google Ads results down by campaign, ad, keyword and search term.
- Break Meta results down by campaign, ad set and ad.
- Report on Microsoft Advertising, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Pinterest, Reddit, X and ChatGPT Ads accounts.

How it works:
Sign in with your PaidSync.ai account, then connect each platform through that platform's own sign-in screen; PaidSync never asks for a platform password in chat. ChatGPT names the account, property or container to read on each question where the tool takes one, or reads the account selected in PaidSync. This app only reads: it changes nothing in your ad accounts, properties or containers.

PaidSync.ai is independent and is not made or endorsed by Google, Meta, Microsoft or the other platforms it connects. Security details: https://paidsync.ai/security

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1. App icon only: the new PaidSync.ai knot symbol replaces the old PS icon. No change to text, tools, server address or sign-in.

positive.description: Lists the accounts to report on.
positive.prompt: List my connected Google Ads accounts.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each Google Ads account with its id, name, currency and status. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: Give me a summary of my Google Ads account for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns spend, clicks, impressions and conversions for the account and period. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: Show my Google Ads campaign performance for last month.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each campaign with spend, clicks, conversions and cost per conversion for last month. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.

positive.prompt: Which of my Google Ads keywords drove the most conversions in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns keywords sorted by conversions with their cost and clicks. If the platform is not connected yet, it calls connect_platform and returns a sign-in link instead.
